events.title: Terraform first released
events.summary: HashiCorp released Terraform 0.1.0 on July 28, 2014 — infrastructure as code for provisioning cloud resources across providers.
events.about: Terraform reads `.tf` files describing AWS, GCP, Azure, and hundreds of other resources, then plans and applies changes with dependency graphs. `terraform plan` shows diffs before `terraform apply` creates or updates infrastructure. It became the lingua franca of multi-cloud [DevOps] alongside Kubernetes and CI pipelines.

narrative.whyChosen: Terraform made multi-cloud infrastructure reproducible, reviewable, and version-controlled.
narrative.whyImportant: It popularized declarative IaC workflows beyond single-vendor cloud templates.
narrative.problemSolved: Click-ops and snowflake servers could not scale; teams needed one tool to describe entire environments.
